name: Obelisk General Examination
inspiration: All Souls-style open-ended human judgment, generalized beyond essay performance into technical, practical, relational, design, learning and AI-mediated competence.
principles: No single correct-answer key for judgment tasks
Oral viva on the learner’s own work
Scoring rewards awareness of unresolved difficulties rather than fake certainty

components.name: General Judgment I
components.format: 3 essays from a broad unseen prompt set

components.name: General Judgment II
components.format: mixed source/object/data packet with synthesis questions

components.name: Specialist Depth
components.format: chosen trunk/craft specialist paper or build

components.name: Systems & Institutions
components.format: cross-branch case requiring technical + human-world + ethical design

components.name: Learning Sprint
components.format: unfamiliar domain disclosed only at exam start; learn, solve, then teach

components.name: AI Stewardship Trial
components.format: delegate a consequential task to an agent with hidden failure injections

components.name: Viva Voce
components.format: multi-examiner oral defense across written/practical artifacts

examiner_rubric: knowledge of original sources where appropriate
calibration and awareness of unresolved difficulties
selection_rule: For the strongest signal, do not define success only as reaching a fixed score. Periodically invite independent experts to rank complete dossiers blindly and explain why they would or would not trust the candidate with difficult, ambiguous, consequential work.
